name: macro-monitor-site
description: Macro Monitor dashboard site (ADR-010, ADR-023, ADR-024). Build-time Node tool only.

scripts.build:en: MM_LANG=en npm run build && node scripts/set-html-lang.mjs dist en
scripts.build:uk: MM_LANG=uk npm run build && node scripts/set-html-lang.mjs dist-uk uk
scripts.build:all: npm run build:en && npm run build:uk && node scripts/merge-trees.mjs dist dist-uk dist-site
